readings: Count tracks for every playlist, including playlists with zero tracks. Divide each count by the average count across all playlists, without rounding. Return the 10 playlists with the highest ratios, showing playlist id, track count, and ratio. Sort by ratio descending with missing ratios last, then by playlist id ascending to break ties.

Count tracks for every playlist. Divide each count by the average count among playlists that have at least one track, without rounding. Return the 10 playlists with the highest ratios, showing playlist id, track count, and ratio. Sort by ratio descending with missing ratios last, then by playlist id ascending to break ties.
queries:
WITH playlist_counts AS (
    SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
    FROM Playlist AS p
    LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
    GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT PlaylistId,
           track_count,
           1.0 * track_count / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM playlist_counts), 0) AS ratio
    FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, ratio
FROM ratios
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, PlaylistId ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH playlist_counts AS (
    SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
    FROM Playlist AS p
    LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
    GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(track_count) AS value
    FROM playlist_counts
    WHERE track_count > 0
)
SELECT pc.PlaylistId,
       pc.track_count,
       pc.track_count / ac.value AS ratio
FROM playlist_counts AS pc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, pc.PlaylistId ASC
LIMIT 10;
